_what_this_is: The intake record for Form 433-B(OIC). Everything established BEFORE any binding was authored, in the fixed order the standing ruling sets: the blank enters forms/ with its SHA in forms.sha256 in the first commit that touches this form, before anything reads it; then revision, catalog and page count FROM DRAWN PAGE BYTES; then enumeration, checkbox probe, the pre-set assertion, and label correlation.
the_filename_trap_was_real: Carried item D-04 recorded that f433boic.pdf 404s and the IRS filename is f433boi.pdf. Downloaded at the recorded name and it returned HTTP 200, application/pdf, 227,483 bytes. Had the wrong name been used it would have presented as a network failure and invited a retry rather than a correction.

from_drawn_page_bytes._method: adapters/pdf/read-form-revision.mjs, which inflates every content stream and reads the footer out of the DRAWN TEXT. The /Info and XMP dictionaries on these IRS hybrids carry stale revisions and are never consulted.
footer_read_verbatim_from_page_1: y=731.2 x=74.1..120.6    "(April 2026)"   — the masthead date, agreeing with the footer revision

enumeration._one_widget_per_field: 267 fields and 267 widgets with none unplaced, so on this form no field carries a second widget. That is NOT true of 433-A(OIC), where CB8_08 has two and they are drawn out of index order (registry L22). Established here rather than assumed either way.
enumeration._derived_by: widget /P resolved against each page's ref, with the page-/Annots scan as the source of truth; no page number is taken from a widget's own /P alone.

checkbox_probe._all_77_share_one_on_state: Every box on this form turns on with /1. 433-A and 433-A(OIC) are not uniform in this, so it is read per form and never carried across.

preset_assertion.inspected: 77 checkbox(es) + 0 radio group(s), 77 widget(s), on /V, /DV and every widget's /AS
preset_assertion.result: PASS — every box on the blank is off on all three, so any tick on a filled copy was put there by the fill engine

line_markers._PAGE_1_DRAWS_NO_NUMBERED_MARKER_AT_ALL: This is the single most consequential fact for slice 1. On 433-A(OIC) a page-1 binding could be anchored to a printed line marker; here there is nothing to anchor to. Every page-1 binding therefore rests on caption geometry, and Prompt 35 ruling 2 applies in its second form throughout: a determinate marker pairing is unavailable, so each binding carries a NAMED SECOND WITNESS.
line_markers._the_12_under_determined: Reported by the tool as its own choice rather than the page's. None is on page 1 (page 1 has no markers), so slice 1 inherits none of them; slices 2-4 must check each against the rectangles before binding.

label_correlation._the_middle_probe_is_the_one_that_matter: It is placed on a cell whose LEAF NAME would agree with the wrong answer. The lineage report found Name_Creditor honest five times on page 3 and false four times on page 5; the probe pins the page-5 reading, so a correlator that drifted back towards the name would fail here rather than pass quietly.

inherited_guards_during_intake._why_this_is_recorded: A guard that never fires on a new form is a guard that has not been tested on new input. Both outcomes are recorded — fired and did-not-fire — because only the pair distinguishes a guard that is working from a guard that is asleep.
FIRED: correlate-labels.mjs PROBES requirement — STOPPED with exit 2 and wrote nothing: "NO PROBES DECLARED for 433boi". Three probes then had to be established from the printed page with align-block.mjs before any label file existed.

correlate-labels.mjs SELF-CHECK — FAILED on the first attempt and wrote nothing. The corrected probe is strictly sharper: (4d) and (4) are 18pt apart in one column and the caption is shared prose while the marker is not.
